name: Vehicle Registration & Title Certificate
summary: Track vehicle registration renewals, titles, roadworthiness certificates, and ownership records worldwide.
whatItIs: A Vehicle Registration Certificate or Title (such as an Indian RC, UK V5C logbook, US DMV title, or European vehicle registration document) is the legal proof certifying vehicle ownership and road authorization. Most jurisdictions require periodic registration renewals, road tax payments, or safety fitness inspections.
wherePeopleLoseIt: Most drivers keep vehicle papers inside the dashboard glove compartment, where physical papers get damaged, misplaced during vehicle maintenance, or forgotten until an on-road traffic inspection or insurance claim.

criticalDates.name: Registration Renewal Date
criticalDates.description: The statutory deadline to renew annual or multi-year vehicle registration fees.

criticalDates.name: Safety & Fitness Inspection
criticalDates.description: Periodic inspection deadlines required by transport authorities to maintain road legality.

whatVaultExtracts: Owner Name & Vehicle Make / Model (e.g. Hyundai VENUE)
Registration Issue Date & Expiry / Renewal Date
howToUse: Photograph both sides of your registration card or forward an official PDF to @squaresvaultbot in Telegram. The bot links the vehicle plate to all future insurance, inspection, and citation uploads automatically.

faqs.q: Can I use SQUARES Vault as official legal proof during traffic stops?
faqs.a: Enforcement officers in many countries require physical originals or designated state government apps (such as DigiLocker or DMV portals). SQUARES Vault acts as your personal life-admin assistant for instant retrieval, proactive renewal reminders, and insurance claim reference.

faqs.q: How does vehicle linking work when I upload other documents?
faqs.a: SQUARES Vault recognizes license plates and vehicle identifiers across documents. Once your vehicle is saved, any insurance schedule, emissions certificate, or service receipt matching that plate is linked under that vehicle.

faqs.q: What happens when my registration approaches renewal?
faqs.a: SQUARES Vault dispatches multi-stage notifications at 10 days, 2 days, and same-day with 1-tap Snooze and renewal links so you never drive with expired tags.

name: Safety & Emissions Inspection Certificate
summary: Track mandatory periodic vehicle inspections, emissions tests, MOT, and smog checks without costly penalties.
whatItIs: Mandatory vehicle inspection certificates (such as emissions testing, UK MOT, US Smog Check, or state roadworthiness certificates) verify that your vehicle satisfies legal safety and environmental emissions standards. Validity cycles typically range between 6 and 24 months depending on jurisdiction and vehicle age.
wherePeopleLoseIt: Inspection slips are often printed on flimsy thermal roll paper at roadside inspection stations or testing bays. Within weeks, the thermal ink fades to blank white paper, leaving vehicle owners unaware that their validity has lapsed.

criticalDates.name: Inspection Validity Expiry
criticalDates.description: The exact date testing validity ends. Operating an uninspected vehicle carries statutory fines, points on licenses, or insurance invalidation.

whatVaultExtracts: Date of Test & Exact Validity Expiry Date
howToUse: Immediately after testing, photograph the paper certificate with your phone and send it to the Telegram bot. SQUARES Vault schedules precision alerts at 10 days, 2 days, and on the expiry day.

faqs.q: Why does automated inspection tracking matter?
faqs.a: Driving with an expired safety or emissions certificate attracts heavy fines, failed road checks, and in many jurisdictions, insurers can deny claims if the vehicle lacked a valid roadworthiness certificate at the time of an incident.

faqs.q: Can thermal paper receipts be read accurately by Gemini AI?
faqs.a: Yes. When photographed in reasonable lighting before thermal ink degrades, Gemini AI reliably extracts the validity date, testing center, and vehicle registration.

faqs.q: How does Snooze work when I get an inspection reminder?
faqs.a: When you receive a reminder that your inspection is due in 2 days, you can tap 'Snooze' to get an alert the next morning during your commute.

name: Auto & Motor Insurance Policy
summary: Track comprehensive and liability coverage, policy renewals, deductibles, and prevent coverage lapses.
whatItIs: Motor insurance protects vehicle owners against third-party liabilities, vehicle damage (collision, fire, theft, natural disasters), and personal injury. Policies are issued on fixed-term cycles (typically annual) with a strict midnight expiration cutoff.
wherePeopleLoseIt: Insurance policies are typically delivered as multi-page PDF schedules buried across email archives. In roadside breakdowns or accident emergencies, finding the policy number, roadside assistance helpline, or deductible terms causes needless panic.

criticalDates.name: Annual Expiry Date
criticalDates.description: The exact midnight deadline when policy coverage ceases.

criticalDates.name: Renewal Grace & No-Claim Discounts
criticalDates.description: Lapsing beyond regulatory grace windows can forfeit accumulated safe-driver or no-claims discounts, requiring expensive re-inspection fees.

whatVaultExtracts: Vehicle Identifier & Insured Declared Value / Valuation
Policy Start Date & Expiry Midnight Date
howToUse: Forward the policy PDF directly from your email to @squaresvaultbot in Telegram. The bot logs the expiry date, calculates the 10-day renewal alert, and files the original PDF in your personal Google Drive.

faqs.q: Why is a 10-day advance reminder so valuable for motor insurance?
faqs.a: Comparing policy terms, evaluating deductibles, and switching insurers takes a few days. Getting alerted 10 days early gives you time to choose the best rate without emergency price spikes.

faqs.q: Does SQUARES Vault mask my sensitive policy information?
faqs.a: Yes. Key identifiers are masked in our database indexes to protect your privacy while allowing full retrieval of the original policy PDF from your Google Drive at any moment.

faqs.q: Can I retrieve my policy details during an on-road emergency?
faqs.a: Yes. Just open Telegram and type 'Send my car insurance' to receive your policy summary and original PDF in seconds.

name: Health & Medical Insurance Policy
summary: Keep policy numbers, covered dependents, deductibles, and renewal dates accessible in any clinic or emergency.
whatItIs: Health and medical insurance (individual or family coverage) covers inpatient hospitalizations, surgeries, prescription benefits, and emergency care. Maintaining continuous renewal is vital because pre-existing condition exclusions and waiting periods reset if a policy permanently lapses.
wherePeopleLoseIt: Insurance member cards and policy certificates are sent as separate files for each family member. During emergency clinic admissions, family members often spend hours digging through old emails to verify coverage limits and member IDs.

criticalDates.name: Annual Premium Renewal Date
criticalDates.description: The target date to renew coverage and maintain continuous health benefit protections.

criticalDates.name: Grace Period Expiration
criticalDates.description: The statutory window where payment must be completed before policy cancellation.

howToUse: Forward your policy certificate to the bot. Type 'When does my health insurance renew?' or 'Give me my health insurance member ID' whenever needed at a medical desk.

faqs.q: Can I share access to medical cards with my partner or family?
faqs.a: Yes. SQUARES Vault includes Family Access Sharing. You can authorize your spouse or adult children to access health insurance records directly from their own Telegram.

faqs.q: Why does continuous renewal matter for medical policies?
faqs.a: Most medical policies have waiting period credits for pre-existing conditions. If you allow coverage to lapse past grace periods, accrued credits can be lost.

faqs.q: Are my medical records kept confidential?
faqs.a: Yes. Files are uploaded directly to your own Google Drive under zero-custodian architecture. SQUARES Vault does not store permanent copies on our servers.

name: Extended Warranties & Protection Plans
summary: Exercise repair and replacement claims on electronics, appliances, and vehicles before coverage expires.
whatItIs: Extended warranties, protection plans, and service contracts provide extended repair and replacement protection on consumer electronics, major home appliances, and motor vehicles beyond standard 1-year factory warranties.
wherePeopleLoseIt: Warranty agreements are often paper leaflets tucked into original boxes or third-party email receipts. When an appliance malfunctions 2 years after purchase, owners assume warranty has expired and pay out of pocket for repairs.

criticalDates.name: Warranty Expiration Date
criticalDates.description: The exact date when manufacturer or third-party repair and replacement coverage terminates.

howToUse: Photograph the warranty certificate or protection plan email when purchasing the product. SQUARES Vault logs the 24, 36, or 60-month duration and notifies you well before coverage lapses.

faqs.q: Why should I track warranties on electronics and home appliances?
faqs.a: Major repairs (such as refrigerator compressors, TV display panels, or laptop motherboards) are costly. Tracking coverage ensures you claim free manufacturer service before expiration.

faqs.q: How does Gemini AI identify warranty terms?
faqs.a: Gemini AI scans the document for model names, purchase dates, warranty duration terms (e.g., '3 Years Comprehensive'), and computes the exact end date.

name: Appliance Invoices & Purchase Receipts
summary: Preserve proofs of purchase for laptops, phones, TVs, and home appliances for warranties, claims, and returns.
whatItIs: Official purchase invoices, store cash memos, and tax receipts serve as conclusive proof of ownership and purchase date for warranty claims, insurance loss claims, and resale valuation.
wherePeopleLoseIt: Retail receipts printed on thermal register rolls fade to unreadable blank paper within 6 to 12 months. When warranty service requires proof of purchase, degraded receipts get rejected.

criticalDates.name: Standard 1-Year Factory Warranty
criticalDates.description: Manufacturer warranty window starting from the documented purchase date.

criticalDates.name: Return / Exchange Window
criticalDates.description: Retail return policy period (typically 14 to 30 days) from purchase.

howToUse: Snap a clear photo of paper store receipts right after unboxing. SQUARES Vault archives high-resolution image copies to your personal Google Drive and logs the item details.

faqs.q: Why photograph receipts immediately after buying?
faqs.a: Thermal paper receipts fade rapidly due to heat and light exposure. Saving a digital copy to your Google Drive ensures indelible proof of purchase years later.

faqs.q: Can I search for receipts by item name?
faqs.a: Yes. Search by product name (e.g. 'Sony TV', 'MacBook', 'Washing machine') and SQUARES Vault brings up the receipt date, amount, and Drive file link instantly.

name: Traffic Citations & Violation Notices
summary: Track automated camera citations, parking notices, and toll invoices before late fees and court dates.
whatItIs: Traffic violation notices, automated speed camera tickets, parking citations, and electronic toll invoices issued against vehicle registrations. Most citations carry statutory payment windows before late surcharges or legal escalations.
wherePeopleLoseIt: Digital camera citations sent via SMS or postal mail are easily forgotten amidst everyday life. Unresolved notices accumulate late penalties, prevent vehicle title transfers, or result in court summons.

criticalDates.name: Due Date for Online Settlement
criticalDates.description: Deadline to pay without late penalties or escalation to virtual courts or collections.

howToUse: Forward the violation notice PDF or SMS screenshot to the bot. SQUARES Vault links the ticket to your vehicle plate and schedules proactive payment alerts.

faqs.q: Why link citations to a vehicle record?
faqs.a: Grouping citations under your vehicle plate ensures you can review all outstanding violation notices in one place before selling or re-registering your car.

faqs.q: Does SQUARES Vault pay the fine for me?
faqs.a: No. SQUARES Vault is a personal life-admin assistant that extracts dates, tracks deadlines, and reminds you before penalties escalate.

name: Utility Bills & Proof of Address
summary: Keep electricity, water, gas, and internet bills organized for proof of residence and on-time payments.
whatItIs: Monthly recurring utility bills (electricity, water, piped gas, municipal taxes, broadband) serve a dual purpose: ensuring on-time household payments and providing fresh, verifiable proof of residence for banks, passport applications, and leases.
wherePeopleLoseIt: Utility statements arrive across varied channels (paper mail, WhatsApp notifications, email alerts). When an organization asks for a 'recent utility bill from the last 3 months', households waste time retrieving portal credentials.

criticalDates.name: Bill Payment Due Date
criticalDates.description: Deadline to pay without late surcharges or disconnection risk.

criticalDates.name: Address Proof Freshness Window
criticalDates.description: Most financial and government bodies require utility bills dated within the last 90 days.

whatVaultExtracts: Billing Period, Due Date & Surcharge Date
howToUse: Forward your e-bill PDF to @squaresvaultbot each month. The bot logs the payment deadline, tracks address proof recency, and files the PDF in your Google Drive.

faqs.q: Why is utility bill organization useful beyond payment reminders?
faqs.a: Having your latest utility bill accessible in Telegram means you can download valid proof of address in 5 seconds while at a bank or administrative office.

faqs.q: Can I ask the bot how much I spent on utilities?
faqs.a: Yes. SQUARES Vault indexes billing amounts so you can ask 'How much were my electricity bills in the last 6 months?'.

name: Passports, Visas & Travel Credentials
summary: Never miss the mandatory 6-month validity window for international travel, visa renewals, and entry requirements.
whatItIs: National passports, residence permits, and travel visas certify citizenship and international travel clearance. Most countries enforce the '6-Month Passport Rule', which denies airline boarding and entry if a passport has less than 6 months of validity remaining.
wherePeopleLoseIt: Because passports last 5 or 10 years, expiry dates are easily forgotten until booking an international flight, leading to cancelled vacations or costly expedited renewal emergencies.

criticalDates.name: 6-Month International Travel Cutoff
criticalDates.description: The effective travel expiration date, after which airlines and immigration deny departure.

criticalDates.name: Final Passport Expiration Date
criticalDates.description: The nominal expiration date of the passport document.

howToUse: Photograph your passport biographical page. SQUARES Vault calculates the 6-month travel advisory window, schedules timely renewal alerts, and securely archives the image to your personal Google Drive.

faqs.q: What is the 6-Month Passport Rule?
faqs.a: Most countries require that international travelers possess a passport valid for at least 6 months beyond their planned stay. SQUARES Vault alerts you when your passport crosses this threshold.

faqs.q: How is my passport privacy protected?
faqs.a: Passport numbers are masked by default in our database indexes (showing only the last 4 digits). The original image is saved to your personal Google Drive under zero-custodian architecture.

name: Residential Leases & Rental Agreements
summary: Track lease start/end dates, notice period deadlines, security deposit returns, and rent adjustments.
whatItIs: Residential lease and tenancy agreements define the contractual relationship between tenants and property owners, establishing rental rates, term duration (typically 12 or 24 months), mandatory notice windows, and security deposit terms.
wherePeopleLoseIt: Physical paper lease deeds end up inside drawers while emailed digital scans get forgotten until the final month. Missing the mandatory 30-day or 60-day notice period frequently causes security deposit disputes or automatic renewals.

criticalDates.name: Mandatory Notice Window Deadline
criticalDates.description: The exact date by which notice to vacate or renew must be formally served.

criticalDates.name: Lease Expiration Date
criticalDates.description: The end of the contractual lease term.

howToUse: Upload your lease agreement PDF to the bot. SQUARES Vault registers the term duration, schedules alerts before mandatory notice windows, and stores the signed contract in your Google Drive.

faqs.q: How does SQUARES Vault protect my lease notice period?
faqs.a: The bot schedules alerts 60 and 30 days prior to lease termination so you have sufficient time to negotiate renewals or serve notice without deposit forfeiture.

faqs.q: Can both landlords and tenants use this?
faqs.a: Yes. Landlords use SQUARES Vault to track lease expirations and rent reviews across multiple rental units, while tenants track their notice periods and deposit receipts.
